entities.summary: Aaron Pryor was an American professional boxer who competed from 1976 to 1990. He was a two-time light welterweight world champion, having held the WBA world title from 1980 to 1983, and the IBF title from 1984 to 1985. Additionally, he held the  Ring magazine title from 1980 to 1983, and the lineal title from 1983 to 1986.
